caption: The video showcases a clear tapered drinking glass resting on a crumpled purple paper backdrop, its exterior fogged with condensation and its upper wall catching bright window-light reflections. Inside, a stack of large, angular, frosted ice cubes fills the middle of the glass, with clear liquid around the lower pieces. Through the early portion the pile of cubes sits largely undisturbed, its frosty faces and clinging droplets holding position. In later views the tall cubes are gone, replaced by a higher column of clear water containing small, rounded fragments in the lower half. The water level rises while the remaining pieces grow fewer and more submerged. Throughout, the glass stays fixed against the purple paper, while the water level and internal reflections change as the ice melts.
relations: As the angular ice cubes melt, their volume shrinks and the clear liquid level rises inside the stationary glass.
The frosty cube faces gradually round into small submerged fragments while the glass stays fixed against the purple backdrop.
Rising water alters internal light paths, shifting the bright window reflections on the upper glass wall.
